claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family can represent the item, action cost, consumable stock, object targeting, and permanence window, but the surface has no effect atom for creating an adhesive bond between objects that persists after setting.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects.ends_on_named_effects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The bond is not generically permanent or dispellable; RAW names a closed set of specific breakers. The current duration/lifecycle surface cannot say that the bond ends only when particular items or spells are applied.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell.
